title: Great for arthritic hands
text: Great for arthritic hands. Bot this to open bottles that couldn't find a way to open. Worked perfectly. Buying another for a friend after hand surgery.

product_metadata.title: Jar Opener, Bottle Opener, Multi Kitchen Tool for Jelly Jars, Ketchup Bottle, Wine, Beer and other, Rubber Jar Opener Easy to Use (2 Pack) (White)
features: Ergonomic and Nonslip Design: Ergonomic design for handling comfortable and offers a firm grip between opener and lid/hand. Rubber handle ensures that you have a strong grip even if your hands are wet
All Size OK: These multifunctional bottle openers fit most kinds of Ketchup bottle, jelly jars, hot sauce bottle
Easy to Use: A good ideal for the elders, kids, arthritic patients and others. Moreover, it makes us keep away from the risk of using knife to open the lid and lower the chance of hurting.
Safety Material & Easy to Clean: Safe and BPA free rubber, no more worry about the sanitation even if it touches the food accidentally. It’s an easy way to clean it because of the simple design.
What you get: A 4-IN-1 Jar Opener and A 5-IN-1 Bottle Opener
